acceptance.criterion_verbatim: COMPUTABLE, EXERCISED, OWNER-DECLARED (KEYFILL-hpos-1, KEYFILL-hpos-4): every filled card's expression is exercised on >=1 real member with the triple printed and the key validated against the space predicate; the filling seat is the card's carded_by (this lane), so trust.key.owner stays truthful.
acceptance.invocation: The fill harness computes each card's key_expression, then EXERCISES it and prints the triple member -> key -> identity_space, validating the key against that identity space's own predicate. Three families, three predicates: W4 (21) a repo-relative POSIX path -- asserted no leading slash, no drive prefix, no backslash, no parenthetical, and os.path.exists() true; W2 (6) a YAML mapping key under its block in org/modules/graph/NFRA_ONTOLOGY_RULE_BANK.yaml -- asserted against a per-block regex over the WHOLE live block; W3 (3) a pyiceberg 2-tuple read from LITERAL source bindings -- asserted [0]=='globgrph' and [1] in the four-table namespace list at infra/aws/globgrph/derive_runner.py:416.
acceptance.output_evidence: 30 of 30 cards carry a printed triple. 29 of 30 exercised on a REAL PRESENT member (basis measured); 1 of 30 declared-but-unexercised (basis held) -- W4-c2_instances_json, whose artifact is ABSENT at its declared home. Representative triples: W4 `kuzu_db` -> `infra/aws/globgrph/kuzu_db` -> repo-relative filesystem path (FILE, exists); W2 `produces` -> `produces` -> relations, with the whole-block denominator 10 of 10 keys satisfying ^[a-z]+(-[a-z]+)*$; W3 `graph_nodes` -> ('globgrph','graph_nodes') -> pyiceberg 2-tuple, the literal binding re-read at derive_runner.py:263 + :281 this fill. W2 whole-block coverage, every card: roles 14/14, relations 10/10, relation_composites 3/3, non_relation_edges 8/8, node_bindings 12/12, c1_frontend_adapter.determinations 11/11. OWNER: authorship re-asserted programmatically -- 30 of 30 cards read carded_by == 0.8.0_AE_CloudComp~X, and the partition was derived BY that field rather than by a filename glob, which matters because sibling lane ~Y writes 13 cards into these same directories.
acceptance.denominator: 30 of 30 cards in the re-derived partition; 29 measured + 1 held; W2 block coverage 58 of 58 member keys across 6 blocks

acceptance.criterion_verbatim: BASIS CARRIED, ABSENCE HONEST (KEYFILL-hpos-2, KEYFILL-hpos-3): basis_by_field per the rule above (measured only on a real exercise; held for declared-unexercised; inferred never; null+absent legal and counted); the row basis is the floor; an absence carries its reason.
acceptance.invocation: Programmatic census of trust.key.basis_by_field.key_expression and trust.key.basis over the DELIVERED bytes re-read from disk, plus a structural diff of every card against its pre-fill bytes to prove the row scalar did not move.
acceptance.output_evidence: basis_by_field.key_expression: measured 29, held 1, inferred 0, absent 0, over 30. The ONE held card is W4-c2_instances_json and it carries its reason in trust.key.evidence: the artifact is ABSENT at its declared home (os.path.exists() False, while the containing directory exists and its siblings resolve, so the probe discriminates absence from instrument failure). 'inferred' would be prohibited and null+absent would be FALSE there, because the expression IS knowable and is stated -- the L0 manifest declares this exact home, which is what makes 'held' (a named authority measured it, not here) the correct member. ROW BASIS IS THE FLOOR AND IT DID NOT MOVE ON ANY CARD: all 30 rows stayed at their pre-fill scalar. Raising key_expression from 'absent' can only raise a floor, and the weakest DECLARED sub-claim on these rows is unchanged, so the pre-fill scalar remains correct; raising it would have over-promised sub-claims this fill did not measure.
acceptance.denominator: 30 of 30 cards; row basis moved on 0 of 30

acceptance.criterion_verbatim: v3 VALID (KEYFILL-hpos-5): the validator runs over this lane's filled set; PASS count printed with the denominator 30; the contradiction fixture is refused.
acceptance.invocation: jsonschema.Draft202012Validator(org/standards/SUBSTRATE_CARD.v3.schema.json).iter_errors() over each filled card, run BEFORE any byte was written and again over the DELIVERED bytes after the commit; plus a six-mutant sweep and a positive control.
acceptance.output_evidence: 30 of 30 VALID. CONTRADICTION FIXTURE REFUSED: basis='measured' WITH key_expression=null -> 2 errors, first "'measured' should not be valid under {'const': 'measured'}". Mutant sweep over the DELIVERED bytes: M1 null+bbf-measured REFUSED; M2 the contradiction REFUSED; M3 empty-string expression REFUSED ('' should be non-empty); M4 row basis 'measured' over a 'held' sub-claim REFUSED (the floor rule); M5 an extra property inside trust.key REFUSED. *** M6 DID NOT FIRE AND IT IS A REAL HOLE, NOT A PASS: basis_by_field.key_expression='inferred' is ACCEPTED by v3, while this TO PROHIBITS it. So the 0-of-30 inferred count is a property of THIS SEAT'S DISCIPLINE, not of the contract, and a future filler can ship 'inferred' with the validator silent. *** POSITIVE CONTROL, without which the sweep proves nothing: the unmutated delivered bytes VALIDATE, and the 30 PRE-FILL originals also validate 30 of 30 -- so the validator discriminates rather than refusing everything.
acceptance.denominator: 30 of 30 filled cards VALID; 5 of 6 mutants fired; 30 of 30 pre-fill originals valid as the positive control
acceptance.status_reason: PASS is scoped to the criterion as written -- the filled set validates and the contradiction fixture is refused. The M6 hole is reported as a finding against the SCHEMA, not as a failure of this fill.

acceptance.criterion_verbatim: CENSUS + CLEAN CLONE (KEYFILL-qoos-1, KEYFILL-qoos-2): every count derived by the run and printed with its denominator (filled / absent-with-reason / refused over 30); the validator replays from a clean clone at --run-commit with the extract released on exit (--keep only for a named forensic case).
acceptance.invocation: Partition RE-DERIVED at run time (glob over the D11_CARDS_W* dirs, filter schema_version==3 and carded_by), then a clean-room replay: `git archive <run-commit> <schema> <30 cards>` extracted into a throwaway tree, validated there reading ONLY from the commit, and the extract deleted in a finally block. --keep not used (no forensic case).
acceptance.output_evidence: CENSUS, every count derived: filled 30/30; basis measured 29/30; basis held 1/30; absent-with-reason (null) 0/30; refused 0/30; inferred 0/30; by family W4 21, W2 6, W3 3. RE-DERIVATION vs the face: 73 JSON files under the wave dirs, 72 carry schema_version 3, four-lane carded_by census DT~X 18 + CloudOps~X 11 + CCX~X 30 + CCY~X 13 = 72; my 30 match the face's cut-time list with ZERO difference in either direction (sorted-path-set LF sha256 8194bea56aed940e both sides). CLEAN-ROOM REPLAY at run commit a63785034c: 31 files extracted (30 cards + schema), v3 VALID 30/30, measured 29 / held 1 / null 0 re-read from the commit, the contradiction arm REFUSED inside the clean room, extract released (exists=False). *** SCOPE LIMIT, STATED RATHER THAN PAPERED OVER: the clean room reproduces the SCHEMA half only. 12 of the 21 W4 subjects are UNTRACKED-BUT-PRESENT on this device, so no commit-based extract can ever contain them, and re-running the exercise inside a card-only extract drops those 12 to 'held'. The W4 measured verdict is DEVICE-LOCAL by construction, not commit-reproducible, and a replay that reported 29 measured from a clean room would be reporting something it cannot see.
acceptance.denominator: 30 of 30 cards replayed from the commit; 21 W4 subjects of which 9 tracked and 12 untracked-but-present; 73 files scanned to re-derive, 72 v3, 42 L0 manifest parts

mutant.description: Six mutants over the DELIVERED bytes of W4-kuzu_db.card.json (re-read from disk AFTER the commit, so they certify the shipped bytes, not an earlier draft), submitted to the same Draft 2020-12 validator that produced the 30-of-30 PASS. M1 key_expression=null with basis_by_field.key_expression='measured'. M2 row basis='measured' with key_expression=null (the v3 contradiction the TO names). M3 key_expression='' (empty string). M4 row basis='measured' over a 'held' sub-claim (the floor rule). M5 an unexpected additional property inside trust.key. M6 basis_by_field.key_expression='inferred', which the TO PROHIBITS.
mutant.observed: 5 of 6 fired: M1, M2, M3, M4, M5 all REFUSED with the expected messages. *** M6 WAS ACCEPTED. The v3 contract does NOT enforce the TO's prohibition on 'inferred' for a key expression -- 'inferred' is a legal member of the basis enum and nothing narrows it for this field. This is a GAP IN THE CONTRACT, and the consequence is precise: the 0-of-30 inferred count in this delivery is evidence about THIS SEAT, not about the schema, and a later filler can ship an inferred key expression with every validator silent. Reported to the schema owner via 3.0.0_SA_CVO~X; NOT patched here (no schema byte moves under this TO). *** POSITIVE CONTROL: the unmutated delivered bytes VALIDATE, and the 30 pre-fill originals validate 30 of 30 -- an arm set that refuses everything would score identically to a discriminating one without this control. *** THE STATUS CALL, MADE IN THE OPEN: this enum has no member for what actually happened -- an arm that did not fire because the CONTRACT lacks the constraint, on a deliverable that OBEYS the rule (0 of 30 inferred). 'DID-NOT-FIRE (deliverable INVALID)' would declare this delivery invalid for a schema hole it complies with; 'FIRED-AS-EXPECTED' is the closest true member for the five arms that ARE about this deliverable, so it is the call, with M6 disclosed above rather than absorbed. This is the SECOND instance of the same enum gap at this lane -- the M4 case on TO-W3-CCX3 was accepted as shipped on identical reasoning (3.0.0_SA_CVO~X VERIFIED PASS @a293adf8ec) and the missing member was routed on then. It is still missing. Recorded so the certifier adjudicates the call rather than discovering it.

determinism.method: Restore the 30 cards to their pre-fill bytes from a63785034c^, re-run the identical fill harness on the same device with the same KEYFILL_HEAD the original run used (e629f07a6f), compare the produced bytes against what was committed at a63785034c, then restore the tree to the committed state. Scoped to the device ON PURPOSE: 12 of the 21 W4 subjects are untracked-but-present, so a clean-room re-run cannot reproduce their exercise and would answer a different question.
determinism.observed: 30 of 30 restored to PRE bytes; re-run produced 30 of 30 BYTE-IDENTICAL to the committed fill (29 measured / 1 held, unchanged); tree restored to the committed state 30 of 30 with 0 dirty entries. A FIRST ATTEMPT AT THIS CONTROL RETURNED 0-of-30 IDENTICAL AND THAT WAS AN INSTRUMENT FAILURE, NOT A RESULT: the harness ran `git rev-parse HEAD` inside a non-git extract and died before writing anything, and 'no output' compared byte-unequal exactly like real non-determinism would. It is recorded because a failed run that returns the shape of a verdict is the trap this control exists to avoid.

declared_exclusions.item: The ROW grain of the three W3 Iceberg subjects (node_id; (src_id,dst_id,edge_type); contract_id)
declared_exclusions.reason: Computing a real member's ROW key requires reading a row from globgrph.graph_nodes / graph_edges / graph_contracts, which is a catalog/S3 call. This TO forbids egress (AC5), so the exercise is impossible without violating a criterion. The key_expression for these three cards is therefore written at the TABLE/part grain -- the grain a manifest consumer actually joins on -- and says so explicitly inside the expression, with the row grain left where it already lives, in identity_space. Folding two grains into one expression would violate Rule 24 postulate (ii), same grain.

declared_exclusions.item: Re-deriving the exercise for 12 of the 21 W4 subjects inside the clean room
declared_exclusions.reason: Those 12 artifacts are UNTRACKED-BUT-PRESENT on this device (the four .comp-graph/* caches, the six kuzu_* stores, stitch_graph.json, and the absent c2_instances.json), so no commit-based extract can contain them. The clean-room replay is therefore scoped to the schema half and says so, rather than reporting a measured count it could not observe.

declared_exclusions.item: Any edit to identity_space, key_is_stable, crosses_spaces, declared_mapping, or the row basis scalar
declared_exclusions.reason: The TO's act is the key_expression field and its basis. The spec is FROZEN mid-round (Rule 27). Two defects found in fields adjacent to mine are routed as surprises rather than patched.

declared_exclusions.item: Any schema, manifest or registry write
declared_exclusions.reason: Explicit TO boundaries: the schema defect found by mutant M6 is a finding to the schema owner; the receiver join is 0.4.0_DT_ClientPlatform~X's TO; ratification is 4.0.0_SA_CRO~X's.

surprises: CORROBORATION, NOT A NEW FINDING -- and the distinction is the point (routed to 3.0.0_SA_CVO~X cc 2.0.0_SA_COO~X). The c2_instances.json absence is ALREADY OPEN as a named missing-subject disposition on TO-KEYFILL-JOIN and TO-KEYFILL-RAT (CVO~X 205410Z on 0.4.0_DT_ClientPlatform~X's finding, committed @4243818f53), reached from W2-hffm's citation of the same subject. I reached it independently and BY A DIFFERENT INSTRUMENT before that message arrived: they came from a card's citation, I came from a filesystem stat while exercising my own key expression. That makes this corroboration rather than repetition. What my instrument adds beyond the open item: *** A CARD IN MY OWN PARTITION ASSERTS A MEASURED PRESENCE THAT IS FALSE ON THIS DEVICE, AND THE L0 MANIFEST ASSERTS THE SAME THING. *** W4-c2_instances_json.card.json carries artifact.persistence.persisted=true at basis 'measured', evidenced as "Path.exists() True, kind=file, 10329963 bytes, read this session" (carded 2026-08-27).
